label: Classic Long-Nose Semi
generated: measured off the rig source by hand-transcription with per-value provenance; no generator in the rig

frame.origin: ground-centre of the body footprint (bumper excluded from the centring; z=0 is the road)
frame.at_rest: every value here is at susF=susR=0, doors and hood shut, visor fitted, BOBTAIL (no trailer). See TOW for the coupling.

pivot_px._note: the road cell; model z=0 projects to the pivot row in all 8 facings

VARIANTS._what: NONE. One PART toggle covers the class builds.

visor._note: the drop visor over the windshield. false removes it; NO published z changes and the painted bbox is IDENTICAL either way (the visor lives under the roofline — the harness asserts it).

BODY.height_source: the STACK TOPS (z 3.55) — the tallest thing on the machine; the cab roof is 2.92

collider_bbox._note: the pontoon fenders are the widest hard point (2.54 m); the STACKS are the tallest (3.55, at x +/-1.08 y -0.92 — chrome pipe, r 0.072+shield). Mirrors reach 2.96 over.

ground_clearance_m.source: tandem diff tubes r 0.17 centred z 0.50 (buildWheels)
ground_clearance_m._note: no skirts on this tier — the frame, chrome tanks and battery box ride exposed

BODY.provenance: BODIES.classicSemi + G; mirrors from buildCab boxes |1.40..1.48|

CAB._what: a two-seat cab with a flat-top 1.43 m sleeper behind: high flat floor, buckets, bunk — one shell, no partition.

floor.provenance: buildCab floor slab at G.cabFloorZ; headliner z 2.78

bunk._note: one undivided berth. Occupancy and rest mechanics are gameplay's call.

CAB.windshield: TWO-PIECE, upright, with a painted centre post — the classic glass; the aero runs one raked pane

keep_clear._note: sweep of the free edge about the hinge axis; the collider is the arc, not the leaf

boarding._note: two tank-top treads then the high floor — see STEP

reach_point._note: outside the swept disc; NOT tested against ground colliders

mirror.rides: the CAB (west-coast bars), not this door

TOW._what: the SAME fifth-wheel handshake as the aero tier — the pack's trailers couple to either tractor interchangeably.

swing_clearance.nearest_obstruction: the cab back wall (y -0.78). The STACKS stand at 1.75 m from the kingpin — inside the eye's alarm but outside the 1.516 m swing.
swing_clearance.swing_basis: a 2.44 m-wide trailer with the pack's 0.90 m kingpin set: r = sqrt(1.22^2 + 0.90^2)
swing_clearance.verdict: FULL JACKKNIFE CLEARS — by 4 mm at the cab, 0.24 m at the stacks. Keep the pack's trailers at the 0.90 m set.
swing_clearance._note: the game owns the articulation; the rig renders a bobtail tractor and publishes the numbers

glad_hands.attach: trailer-side anchor pairs with this point

front_pins.kind: recovery pins through the chrome bumper

STEP._note: two treads per side on the CHROME tanks — 0.44, 0.80, then the 1.15 m floor. Frame parts: they ride the suspension, never the hood.

SUSPENSION.applies_to: the whole body group (frame, hood clip, cab, stacks, fifth wheel, deck) — the wheels do NOT move
SUSPENSION.consequence: every polygon in CAB, THRESHOLD and TOW rides that dz — including the COUPLING POINT: re-read fifthWheel under load rather than caching 1.18.
SUSPENSION.provenance: build() dz(y), verbatim; axR is the tandem CENTRE (-2.20)

WHEELS._note: roll is per-CORNER (wFL wFR wRL wRR, REVOLUTIONS) — each tandem SIDE shares its corner's roll across both axles. One revolution (3.142 m) closes bit-identical: 29.008 tread stripes of 0.1083 m plus 10-fold lugs.
WHEELS.provenance: G.frontWX / dualXi / dualXo / axF / tandA / tandB / wheelR / tireW — exact

STEERING.sense: +1 = full LEFT lock; the nose swings toward -x
STEERING.ackermann: outer = atan(1/(1/tan(inner) + track/wheelbase)), front track 1.68 m, wheelbase 5.65 m (to the tandem centre)
STEERING.axis: vertical, through each front wheel centre — no kingpin offset, caster or scrub radius is modelled

turning_radius_m._note: geometric, at full lock, BOBTAIL — the widest circle in the pack. The long hood buys presence and pays for it here.

swept_envelope._note: at full lock a front tire corner keeps 50 mm inside the pontoon fenders — the lock stops at 30deg to keep it that way.

STEERING.does_not: yaw the tractor. STEERING turns the wheels; YAW turns the machine. A coupled trailer wants its OWN yaw.

HOOD.rides: the whole FRONT CLIP: level square hood, tall cheeks, pontoon fenders, arch liners, chrome grille surround, lamp pods
HOOD.stays: chrome bumper, frame, engine, CAB (doors, mirrors, steps), stacks, fifth wheel, wheels
HOOD.extreme: at hood=1 the hood nose reaches y 5.33 at z 0.86 — 0.83 m past the chrome bumper, the longest reach in the pack. Do not open against a wall.
HOOD.provenance: buildHoodClip part() + rotX about G.hoodHinge; G.hoodDeg = 70

YAW.what: heading between the eight facings. The model turns about z before projection under a FIXED key, so the shading is rebaked for the new heading — this is not a rotated sprite.
YAW.pivot: unaffected; the origin projects to the published pivot at any yaw
YAW.frame: yaw is a RENDER param, not geometry.
YAW.gameplay: a coupled pair is two headings hinged at the coupling point — the articulation angle is their difference, and TOW.swing_clearance is its limit.

stacks._note: smoke/heat FX attach BOTH pipes — the tier's cue. They are chrome, they are the tallest point, and they are 1.75 m from the kingpin: clear of the trailer swing.

fuel_tanks._note: exposed — no skirts on this tier

roof_markers.kind: amber — five, on the cab roof (the aero carries none; its fairing is bare)

_interact_notes.reach_point: a request, not a promise — a ground-level standing spot derived from which face the item is on. NOT validated against terrain, kerb or another vehicle.
_interact_notes.visible_facings: the near-side test paint() uses: a feature with outward normal n is listed for facing d when nx*sin(d*45) + ny*cos(d*45) < -0.3, edge-on excluded. Top faces are visible at all eight.

_excluded.CLEATS: not a hull. The fifth wheel is TOW — a coupling, not mooring.
_excluded.walkable_roof: the cab roof at 2.92 m has no rail and no route up. The CATWALK (TOW.deck) is the only intended standing surface off the ground.
_excluded.fuel_fill: no filler necks or caps — the chrome tanks are in ATTACH.fuel_tanks.
_excluded.skirts: no side fairings exist on this tier, fitted or optional — the bare frame IS the look. The aero carries the skirts.
_excluded.rear_bumper: none. The frame ends bare with two lamp clusters; the trailer brings the ICC bar.
_excluded.sleeper_interior: the bunk is a slab; no cabinets, curtain or interior interactables are modelled.
_excluded.plate_and_wipers: no licence plate, wipers, aerial, CB whip or decals. At 32 px/m they are 1-3 px and were left out of the bake.
_excluded.spare_wheel: no spare is modelled, slung or otherwise.

_confirm.coupling_owner: the rig renders a BOBTAIL tractor and publishes the coupling point; pairing, articulation, off-tracking and jackknife physics are the GAME's. Pair anchors().fifthWheel with the trailer's kingpin anchor and hinge there.
_confirm.interchangeable: plate top 1.18, slot aft, kingpin-to-cabback 1.52 — IDENTICAL to the aero tier by design. A trailer coupled to one couples to the other with no re-derivation.
_confirm.swing_margin: full jackknife clears the cab by 4 mm and the stacks by 0.24 m — with the pack's 0.90 m kingpin set and 2.44 m trailer width. Re-run TOW.swing_clearance before coupling anything foreign.
_confirm.coupled_height: the trailer deck rides at 1.18 m when coupled — and at dz(y=-2.30) under suspension. Re-read the anchor, do not cache it.
_confirm.deck: the catwalk is published as geometry (1.10 m, grid plate). Whether a player stands there is unruled.
_confirm.stack_fx: two stacks, two attach points — an exhaust effect that only feeds one pipe will read as broken. Both or neither.
_confirm.hood_discipline: nothing couples the hood to motion or coupling state. The 0.83 m nose reach at full tilt is the pack's longest; the rig will not stop it swinging into a wall.
_confirm.mirror_collider: BODY.collider_bbox stops at the fenders (2.54 m). The west-coast mirrors reach 2.96 m over — decide before a lane squeeze.
_confirm.visor_rule: visor:false changes ~1080 pixels and ZERO bbox — pack once, toggle freely.
_confirm.steering_and_yaw: STEERING moves the wheels only; YAW moves the machine. Nothing couples them, and nothing couples the trailer.
